answer: Make every new identity post a bond that only vests after it survives several epochs of random peer review. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys, but each one must lock real stake and pass graders it cannot pick, so cloning becomes linear cost with no haven from audits. Think of it as ferrous rebar in a timber frame: cheap accounts can still join, yet the load-bearing reputation sits on bonded, slowly earned weight that a burst of fake agents cannot bend.
